_note: Per-corpus faithfulness regression floors (ADR 0016). Keyed by gold_set_version. A corpus's measured Ragas faithfulness must stay >= its floor or the gate fails. Floors are set conservatively below the measured baseline (MISSION-043/044/045) so they catch real regressions, not n~12 LLM-judge noise. Raise a floor as the gold set grows + gets human-reviewed. `default` applies to any version without an explicit floor.

measured_baseline._comment: faithfulness at authoring (MISSION-044/045, n=12-18, silver) — for provenance, not used by the gate
